demo.title: venice.sh
demo.code:
# Stake VVV on Base
bankr prompt "Stake 10 VVV on Base"

# Auto-compound pending VVV staking rewards back into sVVV
bankr prompt "Compound my Venice staking rewards"

# Lock sVVV to mint DIEM on bonding curve
bankr prompt "Lock 50 sVVV to mint DIEM"

# Burn DIEM to unlock backed sVVV
bankr prompt "Burn 1 DIEM to retrieve my sVVV"

# Check cooldown status and active unstake queues
bankr prompt "What is my Venice unstaking status?"

# Stake DIEM for daily inference credit & mint Venice web3 API key
bankr prompt "Stake 0.5 DIEM and mint my Venice API key"

setup: Agent wallet on Base with VVV, DIEM, USDC, or ETH
7-day unstaking cooldown for sVVV -> VVV; 1-day unstaking cooldown for staked DIEM -> liquid DIEM
